test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bigger fish to fry

options.text: Having something more important to take care of
Having work more than one’s capacity
To be similar to one’s parents in some way

solution:
The correct answer is: **Having something more important to take care of**.
